name: models3d_text_generate
description: Text-to-3D GLB from a prompt. Every provider returns a textured model by default; texture=false returns bare geometry, which on Meshy costs half. No source image. For image-to-3D use `models3d_generate`.

aiModel.description: Meshy only: the engine. Default meshy-7.1; meshy-t2 runs smart topology.

decimationMode.description: Meshy standard remesh only: adaptive decimation, replaces targetPolycount.

enablePbr.description: PBR maps alongside the base colour. Not with texture=false. Hunyuan bills it extra.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

generateParts.description: Tripo v3.0/v3.1 only: hand back the mesh split into separate parts. Forces texture off.

modelType.description: Meshy only: standard (the aiModel engine), smart-topology (meshy-t2, 100–15,000 faces), or lowpoly.

modelVersion.description: Tripo version; the newest is the default. v3.1-20260211 is Tripo H3.1.

negativePrompt.description: What to keep out of it.

provider.description: Tripo (default), Meshy on the aiModel engine, smart topology (T2), or lowpoly, or Hunyuan 3D v3.1 Pro (prompt, texture and enablePbr only). All are textured unless texture=false.

shouldRemesh.description: Meshy standard only: remesh the preview. Default false.

targetPolycount.description: Meshy smart-topology: 100–15,000. Standard with shouldRemesh=true: 100–300,000, when decimationMode is omitted.

texture.description: Default true. false returns bare geometry; on Meshy that skips the refine and costs half.
